reasoning: PKGBUILD demonstrates safe practices (HTTPS source, pinned checksum, standard installation hooks), but critical executable (AppImage) was skipped in audit.
coverage_issues: Both models skipped Eden-Linux-*.AppImage – the primary executable containing all runtime behavior. This is a critical coverage gap.
false_negatives: AppImage may contain: 1) Network calls during execution 2) Filesystem access outside package scope 3) Dynamic code loading – all unverified due to skipped audit.
learnings: File selection: Prioritize executable binaries in -bin packages. Implement AppImage extraction for content audit.
Assessment quality: Models correctly assessed PKGBUILD but failed to flag binary-skip as critical risk.
Failure mode: Binary skipping creates false negatives. Require explicit risk acknowledgment for skipped executables.
